# Quizora
> Discover. Challenge. Share.

Website: https://quiz.wdbloog.com

Quizora is a free, modern international quiz platform offering 21 original quizzes across seven key categories:
1. Personality (What Is Your True Personality Type?, Discover Your Hidden Strengths, Which Personality Archetype Are You?)
2. Love & Relationships (How Well Do You Know Your Partner?, What Is Your Love Language?, How Compatible Are You and Your Partner?)
3. General Knowledge (General Knowledge Challenge, World Geography Quiz, History Knowledge Test)
4. Brain & Intelligence (Test Your Logical Thinking, Tricky Riddles Challenge, Brain Training Challenge)
5. Entertainment (Which Movie Character Matches Your Personality?, Guess the Movie from Emojis, How Well Do You Know Popular Movies?)
6. Sports (Football Knowledge Challenge, Guess the Famous Football Player, Football Legends Trivia)
7. Friends & Social (How Well Do Your Friends Know You?, Introvert or Extrovert?, What Kind of Friend Are You?)

Key Features:
- 100% Client-side execution without external AI or database dependencies.
- HTML Canvas dynamic social share card generation (1080x1080 square and 1080x1920 Instagram Story format).
- Head-to-head friend challenge link mechanism with score comparison.
- Verified knowledge scoring and multi-trait personality archetype classification.
- AdSense monetization integration (Publisher ca-pub-3618365568004987).
